title: Chapter 505
paragraphs: Chapter 505
139. Threat (4)
It took just a second, or even less than that.
If it had taken any longer, the ship's blueprint would have been irreparably damaged.
Seeing the fire in Jin's hand die down, they all remained motionless for a while, relieved to see the blueprint was safe.
"In any case,"
Jin said with a blank expression as he put the blueprint and the machine back into his coat pocket.
"It would be best not to break your promise or betray us. If you want to leave room for negotiation with me regarding the blueprint and the machine later on."
"......Quite presumptuous for someone who worries about such things, Mr. Jin. Don't worry, there will be no such thing. However,"
Jephilin revealed an intense murderous intent, which was enough to make the hairs on his skin stand on end.

"In the future, you will have to negotiate with us about the items in some way. If you just swallow them and wipe your mouth clean, I don't know what I'll do to you. I'll tear you to shreds, orders or not."
"You're trying to maintain a fierce atmosphere until the end. If you kill Jin, I'll tear you into not just a thousand, but ten thousand pieces."
"Living Golem, humans already have short lives. Don't hasten death too much. Do you want me to tell you how many semi-immortal beings I've sent to hell in my lifetime?"
Jin tapped Sandra's shoulder with his finger, signaling her not to provoke Jephilin anymore.
"I intended to negotiate with Kinzelo anyway. We got the blueprint, but our family lacks the technology to decipher or implement it."
There was no need to hide or sugarcoat this weakness.
Runecandle had survived a thousand years with just a single sword.
Since they had rejected magic so extremely, it was natural that they had contributed little to the development of civilizations derived from that research.
During that time, other major forces had achieved all sorts of technological progress and innovation. This included Zipfel, the Royal Family, and recently, Kinzelo, who had gained prominence.
'Maybe it was a miracle that our family survived until now just by force. On the other hand...it could be that the Runecandle phenomenon was so remarkable.'
The overwhelming individual power that the Runecandles possessed was coming to an end after a thousand years of respite.
All the current Runecandles were painfully aware of this.

Now, Runecandle needed something else. In fact, the first significant advancement since Temar, the establishment of the new Runecandle Knights, was paradoxically proving this more clearly than anything else.
Even though a new Runecandle Knight had finally appeared, Runecandle still could not prevent its fundamental decline.
It was time for change.
And little by little, things were changing. Among the Knights, there were certainly those who were attempting or considering change.

Jin, who declared the return of the Demonic Sword, Joshua, who believes in the power of prophecy, and Difus, who became convinced of the need for innovation due to this incident, were representative examples.
Each of them was thinking about these changes.

"We need to buy as much time as possible before escaping the desert and sitting down at the negotiation table with Kinzelo. We have to secure at least some information about the blueprint and the device. Otherwise, we'll have no choice but to accept a lousy deal."
"Negotiation? We don't need that, little one. Even without Kinzelo's technology, we already have the means to produce the airships."

"Joshua, Mother, and that Prophet... maybe they have a way to produce airships. Protecting the blueprint from our family and choosing between our family and Kinzelo for a deal won't be easy. It would be less burdensome if we deal with Joshua before going back."
Difus hadn't given up on killing Joshua.
"If possible, I'll assassinate him before escaping the Sota Desert. If I can't kill him this time, I'll create an opportunity when we return to the family. It's the path for our family."
Zepherin smiled brightly, hiding her agitated emotions again.
"You're right, the objects are like a pearl necklace on a pig's neck for Runekandel. There won't be any more deception in the next negotiation. So enjoy today's small victory, Master Jin."
Jin, Murakan, Yona, Joshua, Difus, Jane, Sandra, and Zepherin.
Thus, an odd and uncomfortable journey began.
In the sky and on the ground, Zipel and Kinzelo were still engaged in fierce battles, and the dawn of the desert was coming to an end.
Being protected by one enemy from another was not a pleasant experience.
The expressionless Runekandel members felt a heavy burden in their hearts.
Though not visible yet,
The party sensed that the net of pursuit from the Revenant was narrowing.
"In two hours at most. They will surely find us within that time. I hope we won't be discovered until we escape the desert."
Zepherin is strong. Her confidence in being able to compete with Murakan in his prime wasn't false.

However, Jin thought that she, too, was not in a perfect condition like Murakan. She wasn't in good shape when they first fought in the Black King Mine, and the shock from that time would still be lingering.

In fact, Zepherin did not possess the transcendent power of Hedo. Her strength came from the Kinzelo commander, who was in desperate need of stability after the aftermath of the Sword Emperor's terror.
"Even if Zepherin is in perfect condition contrary to my thoughts, she cannot face the entire Revenant alone."
That would be impossible for Hedo as well.
If anyone discovers the party, they will shoot a flare, and then the entire Revenant will swarm in.
"Besides, Zepherin won't protect us at the cost of her life. In the worst-case scenario, she can easily abandon us and the items and escape on her own."
Jin glanced back for a moment.
He intended to check the situation of Zipel and Grunil fighting in the sky behind them.
Zepherin chuckled at his gaze.
"It seems you're worried. Grunil won't be joining our escort after pushing Zipel back, so don't get your hopes up."
"We're not in a crisis that requires more help from our enemies. It's just another confirmation that the power of your airships has become stronger since then."
"Anyway, Master, it seems you would float your mouth even if you drowned in water."
"You're just a kind of insurance. And insurance doesn't talk. If you don't want to get scolded by Murakan or Sandra again for no reason, just follow quietly."
"Alright."
If you escape the Sota Desert in the opposite direction of the Kuta Forest, you will find the Romin Forest, and beyond that forest lies the central border of the Lutero Magical Federation.

The border is guarded by Zipl and five autonomous districts and eight autonomous states. If you get through all of them, you will reach the sea, the Lutero West Sea, and then you have to get out quite a bit further to reach the neutral waters.

The very center of the federation is nearly impossible to infiltrate or escape from. The former was done relatively easily through the infiltration route created by the Prophet, but that route could not be used for escape.

The group was already moving under the assumption that the infiltration route and tunnels created by the Prophet were being discovered one by one. As a result, their speed was slow, and the burden of unforeseen dangers was greater.
Sigh, sigh...
In the midst of the sound of the blowing sandstorm, the rough breathing of one of the group members was becoming more and more pronounced.
It was the breathing of the Black Knight, Jane.
She was the most injured in the battle against Hedo. Even as a Black Knight, she couldn't endure the continuous bleeding and reflux without showing any signs of pain.
"Knight Jane, are you alright?"
She nodded her head, but her whole body was shaking like a withered tree.
With each step, blood overflowed from Jane's boots.
When she carefully lifted her cloak, the sight of her exposed ribs between her torn infiltration suit and bandages appeared.
'Sigh...!'
Black blood poured out from between her pale bones.
The reason she was still walking was that she was a Black Knight. If she wasn't a Black Knight, she would have already passed out and met her death.
"...We need to change the bandages."
"Ugh."
Even with the healing magic-infused bandage, it was barely an emergency treatment.
She sensed her death. Not only her but everyone felt it. This time, they couldn't hide their complicated emotions.
'Although she followed Joshua, she is the black helmet of the family... More devoted than anyone else. Is this the only way to let her go?'
If they don't leave as soon as possible, Jane will definitely die.
But there was no way they could escape that quickly. While the group changed the bandages, Sandra handed Jane a painkiller.

"This is what I take when I have side effects from experiments. If you swallow it, you'll feel better. It's the most effective painkiller in the world. Don't be in pain, because it seems like Jin will be sad. It interferes with our date."
Jin stared intently at the painkiller.
While looking at it, the thoughts that came to mind made him unbearably hate himself.

"It's a tear-jerking scene. Do you have a handkerchief by any chance? I'll need one too. But it seems like death is unavoidable, wouldn't it be better to let go peacefully? Considering the escape efficiency, that seems to be the better option."
With that, Zephyrin pointed ahead.
The edge of the Lomin Forest was visible.

"The forest has been tightly surrounded by a net ever since the drying-field terror began. Except for the border guards' younger sisters, no one can sneak out through the dense network. Breaking through by force is necessary, but do you think it's possible with a patient?"
There was no need to verify the truth of the statement.
Aside from teleportation and flight, the directions of Kuta Forest and Lomin Forest were the only escape routes. There was no way Zipel would leave the area unguarded.
'At least we've made it this far without the wraiths finding us, so it's okay for now.'
Jin met Zephyrin's eyes.
"It would've been difficult without you. That's your role, Zephyrin."
"Huh?"
"Break through to the right first and attract their attention. We'll escape through the desert after the encirclement focuses on you."

"Wouldn't it be more reasonable for me to play the decoy role after we've all made a quick breakthrough to the border? If there's an uproar, the wraiths will come too. Are you really planning to use me as bait here, thinking that the Black Knight can survive?"
Jin didn't answer.
"You know it's impossible for all of us to return alive, right? You're being too greedy, Sir Jin. The Black Knight is already half-dead."
"Shut up and go. It's not your place to judge, it's mine."
Jin's refusal to give up on Jane's life was not just due to emotional reasons.
Zephyrin and Sandra, who was actually agreeing with his opinion while not showing it, couldn't know this fact.
"And why are you worried about me? It shouldn't be too bad for you."
At those words, Zephyrin shrugged.

"Well, I'll do as you say. As you said, there's no harm to me. It's a bit uncomfortable, but I can see you won't back down. The life of the Black Knight... I thought you were always cold-hearted, but you do have a soft spot."
For Zephyrin, it was actually better if Jin's group fell into a crisis while he was being used as bait.
There would be no chance during the escort, but the possibility of stealing items would be higher while Jin's group was struggling to escape Zipel's pursuit.
Kinzel wasn't the only one here.
Moreover, after becoming the bait, he could easily return to Jin without being caught. It would be the best outcome for Zephyrin if Jin was in a dire situation at that time.
"See you at the border. Take good care of the items."
